composition: Position the main subject dead-center, occupying 55% to 70% of the 1:1 frame.
Surround the subject with dark, high-contrast negative space to ensure separation.
Apply a slight 5 to 15-degree tilt to lettermarks to inject dynamic gaming energy.
Use precise, symmetrical vector geometry or interlocking shapes for non-lettermark emblems.
typographie: Use bold, chiseled, or customized sans-serif and serif letterforms with angled cuts or split-block designs.
Integrate text directly with graphic elements using overlapping layers (e.g., wrapping elements through letter curves).
Enclose secondary text in custom geometric frames or badges to maintain a unified silhouette.
Scale text to occupy no more than 75% of the frame width to prevent edge crowding.
lumiere: Apply dual-source lighting: a cool primary light (blue/cyan) paired with a warm/vibrant rim light (magenta/pink/gold).
Use top-down directional lighting to create metallic reflections and cast soft drop shadows below.
Incorporate a soft, atmospheric backlighting halo to separate the central subject from dark backgrounds.
etalonnage: Use high-contrast palettes: deep blacks (#000000) paired with electric cyan (#00B0FF), hot pink (#FF007F), or emerald green (#004D30).
Employ monochromatic metallic gradients ranging from deep bronze (#5C3A00) to bright yellow-white highlights.
Keep background tones desaturated and dark to let highly saturated vector elements pop.
effets: Add subtle 3D chiseled extrusions, metallic gradient mapping, and sharp vector bevels.
Apply soft outer glows, subtle corner light leaks, and low-opacity background textures (concrete, paper, or noise).
Incorporate dynamic elements like floating shards, clean vector sparkles, or soft smoke wisps.
logo: Center the primary emblem, lettermark, or monogram as the absolute focal point of the canvas.
Ensure the logo maintains a clean, high-resolution vector-style silhouette that remains legible at small scales.
interdits: Do not use generic, unedited brush presets for sparkles or light leaks.
Avoid muddy, overly dark backgrounds that swallow the emblem's silhouette.
Do not include tiny, secondary icons that lose legibility and scale poorly.
Avoid disconnected background patterns that clash with the central theme.
Do not export at low resolutions that cause pixelation on sharp vector bevels.
